## Zoning & Development Analysis: 3400 N Central Park Ave (PIN 13233160400000)

---

### 1. Zoning District in Effect

This parcel is zoned **RS-3 (Residential Single-Unit — Detached House)**, per the City of Chicago's official GIS zoning layer. You can verify this at the [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning) by entering the address or PIN.

RS-3 is the most permissive of the three RS sub-districts, intended primarily for detached houses on individual lots, differentiated from RS-1 and RS-2 mainly by minimum lot area requirements and floor area ratios [5].

---

### 2. Could You Build a Two-Flat Here?

**Possibly, yes — but only under a specific exemption, not as-of-right.**

The base RS-3 district is designed for single-unit detached houses [5]. However, [1] provides a critical exemption: in RS-3, the minimum lot area per dwelling unit **may be reduced to 1,500 sq ft** (allowing a two-unit building) when **either**:
- 60% or more of zoning lots fronting the same side of the street between the two nearest intersecting streets have been lawfully improved with buildings containing more than one dwelling unit, **or**
- the property is located within the "Predominance of the Block" boundaries as defined by Section 17-7-0591.

This exemption **only allows establishment of a two-unit building** — not more [1]. You would need to verify whether the block meets the 60% threshold (a survey of existing multi-unit buildings on your block face) or whether the parcel falls within a mapped "Predominance of the Block" boundary.

**Note:** The existing building on this parcel is recorded as a **5-unit, 2-story masonry structure** built in 1927 — this may reflect a pre-existing nonconforming use under current RS-3 zoning. That's a significant consideration for any redevelopment plan.

---

### 3. Key Bulk and Density Standards (RS-3)

The context does not include the full RS-3 bulk standards table (the `zone_definition` field was not returned), so I can only provide what the code chunks confirm:

- **Minimum lot area per unit:** The base RS-3 standard applies per [1] (the ordinance cross-references Section 17-17-0304 for measurement rules). The two-flat exemption reduces this to **1,500 sq ft per unit** when conditions are met [1].
- **Other bulk standards (FAR, maximum height, front/side/rear setbacks):** These are specified in the RS-3 bulk table under §17-2-0300, but the specific numeric values for FAR, height limits, and setback dimensions were **not returned in the zone definition data** for this query. You can look these up directly in [1] (§17-2-0300) via the [Chicago Municipal Code](https://codelibrary.amlegal.com/codes/chicago/latest/chicago_il/0-0-0-2620486) or the Zoning Map.
- **Ground floor Type A accessible units** are exempt from lot-area-per-unit calculations in RS-3 [1], which is relevant if any unit is designed to ADA Type A standards.

> ⚠️ I was **not able to confirm** the specific FAR cap, maximum building height, or exact setback dimensions for RS-3 from the data returned. Consult §17-2-0400 and §17-2-0500 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance directly, or contact the Chicago Department of Planning and Development (DPD) at (312) 744-5777.

---

### 4. Overlays and Special Designations

Several overlays apply to this parcel:

- **Special District:** The parcel is within a mapped Special District. The specific name and associated regulations were not returned in this query — verify via the [Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning) or contact DPD.
- **Transit-Oriented Development (CTA):** The parcel is within a CTA TOD overlay. The nearest CTA rail station is **Addison (Blue Line), approximately 0.26 miles away**, and the nearest Metra station is **Irving Park (Union Pacific Northwest), approximately 0.91 miles away**. The Connected Communities Ordinance (TOD overlay) may allow density and parking bonuses — see item 5 below.
- **ADU Eligible Area:** This parcel is within a designated **Additional Dwelling Unit (ADU) Allowed RS Area** under [2] (§17-7-0570). This is highly relevant — see item 6 below.
- **Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) Zone:** The parcel is within an ARO zone. If a project triggers the ARO (generally applicable to projects receiving city financial assistance or requiring a zoning map amendment), affordable unit requirements may apply. The Irving Park community area already has 2 ARO-supported projects totaling 65 affordable units (Independence Apts. at 4022 N. Elston Ave. — 14 senior units; Senior Residence at Kedzie at 4054 N. Kedzie Ave. — 51 senior units).
- **No Planned Development:** Not in a Planned Development.
- **No Landmark or Historic District:** Not a landmark building, not in a landmark or historic district, not on the National Register of Historic Places. No Commission on Chicago Landmarks review is required for exterior alterations on this basis.
- **No Special Service Area (SSA):** Not within an SSA.
- **No Lakefront Protection or Pedestrian Street overlay.**
- **Flood Zone X (Minimal Hazard):** FEMA designates this parcel as Zone X — an area of minimal flood hazard. It is **not** in a Special Flood Hazard Area (SFHA), so federally mandated flood insurance is not triggered.
- **Brownfield sites nearby:** Two BNSF Little Village Paseo brownfield sites (EPA IDs 110071982538 and 110071982539) are recorded in the vicinity. While these are not on this parcel, environmental due diligence (Phase I/II ESA) may be advisable before ground disturbance.

---

### 5. Parking Requirements and Transit-Related Reductions

Under [3] (§17-10-0601), in RS districts:
- Required off-street parking must be located **on the same zoning lot** as the dwelling units served [3].
- Off-street parking is **prohibited in side setbacks** and within **20 feet of the front property line**, except when accessed by a permitted driveway from the front [3].

The **specific number of required spaces** for RS-3 residential uses is set in the RS parking table (§17-10-0100), which was not returned in full. The existing building has a **3-car garage**, which may already satisfy or partially satisfy any requirement.

**TOD Reduction:** Because this parcel is within the CTA TOD overlay (Addison Blue Line station 0.26 miles away), the Connected Communities Ordinance may permit parking reductions or waivers for qualifying projects. The specific reduction percentage depends on the use type and proximity tier — verify with DPD or review §17-10-0100 for TOD parking tables.

> ⚠️ The precise parking ratio (spaces per unit) for an RS-3 two-flat or multi-unit project was **not returned** in this query's code chunks. Confirm with DPD or review §17-10-0102 of the Zoning Ordinance.

### 6. Coach House / Additional Dwelling Units (ADUs)

**Yes — this parcel is in an ADU Eligible Area, which is the key gateway condition.**
